name: Casa
author: NucleoOS
description: Home Assistant dashboard: lights, switches, covers, thermostats, locks, scenes and sensors, grouped by room. Tap to toggle, hold for brightness and details. Needs Home Assistant URL and token in Settings > Home.

descriptions.en: Home Assistant dashboard: lights, switches, covers, thermostats, locks, scenes and sensors, grouped by room. Tap to toggle, hold for brightness and details. Needs Home Assistant URL and token in Settings > Home.
descriptions.it: Pannello di Home Assistant: luci, prese, tapparelle, termostati, serrature, scene e sensori, divisi per stanza. Tocca per accendere/spegnere, tieni premuto per luminosita e dettagli. Serve indirizzo e token di Home Assistant in Impostazioni > Casa.
